title: TileAddress
description: Complete spatial descriptor for one visible trixel tile. Encodes world position, camera-relative orientation, visible face, and recipe reference.

world_cell.description: Absolute [x, y, z] grid position in world space

camera_relative.description: Maps world axes to camera-relative directions for this view

visible_face.description: Which face of this cell is visible to the camera

view_vector.description: Normalised vector from camera toward tile

surface_normal.description: Outward normal of the visible face

tile_address.description: Compact address string encoding position and camera-relative direction. Format: {h_prefix}{x}.{v_prefix}{y}.{d_prefix}{z}

recipe.description: Recipe identifier: terrain type and variant, e.g. 'volcano.branching_lava'

neighbor_cells.description: Adjacent cells in face-neighbor order [top, bottom, north, south, east, west]
